svg.title: Warthog connections
svg.desc: A laptop connects over USB Ethernet and a phone over 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi to Warthog, an ESP32-S3 with an MM6108 HaLow module. Both share one sub-GHz uplink, either a HaLow access point or an 802.11s mesh. USB also carries power and an AT console. NAT is the default.
svg.text: USB + Wi-Fi together · NAT by default
